source: import { existsSync, statSync, unlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; function main(): void { const path: string = '/tmp/thaw-node-compat-stat.txt'; writeFileSync(path, 'abc'); const stat = statSync(path); console.log(existsSync(path), stat.isFile(), stat.size); unlinkSync(path); }
